node="[object Object]">Based on public web sources, here's what's known about the <strong>askFDALabel widget/tool</strong> as of June 2026:</p>
<ul class="my-1 ml-4 list-disc text-base text-inherit [&amp;&gt;li]:mt-1" node="[object Object]">
<li class="text-base text-inherit" node="[object Object]">
<p class="font-normal mt-2 text-base text-inherit" node="[object Object]"><strong>The underlying FDALabel database is active and regularly maintained</strong>, with recent data updated as of April 15, 2026. It contains over 155,000 human prescription, biological, OTC, and animal drug labeling documents sourced from FDA's Structured Product Labeling (SPL) archive. <a href="https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEIaIooJABAvyHgVWsWh5phoIn5HmixCbJqSnT-dsP_BbJZpt9WPvT5wyt9UxrbWwxwcf_Hb_WRuGJW1RwZMfON9gOB2kWjxKvd52FV5S7HLTybD2tHJwLQNBjnN_lCY0JjhbS2y1-Mq7UoOf73r-5vllPK8iQVZQqwJKBWHZclPMwrdJ_937ktSgvzvSFXwJWBdq8gaG8pLXh7f2HUDkwsN-ffHQ==" class="font-medium text-base text-primary underline underline-offset-1" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" node="[object Object]">🔗</a></p>
</li>
<li class="text-base text-inherit" node="[object Object]">
<p class="font-normal mt-2 text-base text-inherit" node="[object Object]"><strong>AskFDALabel (the LLM-powered framework)</strong> is described as active and evolving, with <strong>version 2</strong> accepted as of January 20, 2025. This version introduced improvements such as term-of-interest recognition and an enhanced retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) process. <a href="https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHL6dXwX-bSJRGALbS4iCGjNXnTl25zhztK6NIRA0FCdhmwH1nCL7WzBPEsgpUMqiSAWt8hNU4h5h3bM2enAKcdnSYURxP8OCkuCT8LCoqn0J_0ErgTVqE2D4lJfyatwwwqyQhgEgk8Cu-2ULhI" class="font-medium text-base text-primary underline underline-offset-1" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" node="[object Object]">🔗</a></p>
</li>
<li class="text-base text-inherit" node="[object Object]">
<p class="font-normal mt-2 text-base text-inherit" node="[object Object]">The tool has demonstrated <strong>high consistency with human adverse event annotation</strong>, particularly for drug-induced liver injury and cardiotoxicity classification, supporting its use in drug safety research. <a href="https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHvTGhwkh29n2kdrEjkhJMZNCRDyd5ChzOZ8UFtgDZfG5qoIi_p4KTErL4sqthl1W_n1vBILMU0yLAmvoPo_83b2P3tgJkEVXtoT_PVYqV9fhpqDaEiS5gn4bSZf2UHwLBCmuq_" class="font-medium text-base text-primary underline underline-offset-1" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" node="[object Object]">🔗</a></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="font-normal mt-2 text-base text-inherit" node="[object Object]">That said, if you're referring specifically to the <strong>widget</strong> (i.e., an embeddable UI component), I'd recommend checking directly with your internal team or the FDALabel platform administrators, as the operational status of specific front-end widgets may differ from the underlying tool/API being active. Would you like help finding more specific information or a point of contact?</p></div></div><div class="flex flex-row items-center gap-0.5 pt-2 opacity-0 transition-opacity ## Debugging Script
Copy and paste the following script into the Developer Tools Console on the Elsa page to diagnose the widget failure:

```javascript

(function() {

    let out = [];

    out.push("=== AskFDALabel Diagnostics ===");

    out.push("Widget Loaded Flag: " + !!window.ASKFDALABEL_WIDGET_LOADED);

    

    const inputs = document.querySelectorAll('textarea, [contenteditable="true"]');

    out.push(`Found ${inputs.length} inputs.`);

    inputs.forEach((input, i) => {

        out.push(` Input ${i}: type=${input.tagName}, editable=${input.contentEditable}, hooked=${input.dataset.askfdalabelHooked}`);

    });

    

    const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('button');

    let sendButtons = [];

    buttons.forEach(button => {

        const isSendButton = 

            (button.innerText || '').toLowerCase().includes('send') ||

            (button.getAttribute('aria-label') || '').toLowerCase().includes('send') ||

            (button.getAttribute('aria-label') || '').toLowerCase().includes('ask the ai') ||

            button.querySelector('svg.lucide-send') !== null ||

            button.closest('[data-tour="tour-send"]') !== null;

        if (isSendButton) {

            sendButtons.push(button);

        }

    });

    out.push(`Found ${sendButtons.length} send buttons.`);

    sendButtons.forEach((btn, i) => {

        out.push(` Send Button ${i}:`);

        out.push(`  - Aria-label: ${btn.getAttribute('aria-label')}`);

        out.push(`  - Hooked: ${btn.dataset.askfdalabelHooked}`);

    });



    out.push("Testing text injection on the first input...");

    if (inputs.length > 0) {

        let input = inputs[0];

        input.focus();

        const sel = window.getSelection();

        sel.selectAllChildren(input);

        sel.collapseToEnd();

        const success = document.execCommand('insertText', false, " [TEST INJECTION]");

        out.push(`  - execCommand returned: ${success}`);

        out.push(`  - Current innerText after injection: ${input.innerText.substring(Math.max(0, input.innerText.length - 40))}`);

    }

    out.push("=== End Diagnostics ===");

    console.log(out.join('\n'));

})();

```
